title: Object & watermark remover (patch fill)
description: Diffs the pixels around a masked area into the gap to remove date stamps, watermarks and small blemishes. A deterministic patch fill — good on small marks, not a substitute for inpainting a large subject out of a photo.
x-privacyfold-engine: none (plain JavaScript in the browser tab)

input.description: An image file (data URI or pasted File) processed in the tab; never uploaded.
